verdict.rationale: Cline offers a documented CLI/headless mode, ACP protocol, MCP tool access, subagents, and cron scheduling that mirror much of the UI's agentic functionality, and docs state the same core engine powers CLI, Kanban, VS Code and JetBrains surfaces (cline-docs-19, cline-docs-3, cline-docs-13, cline-docs-26). However, a probe found no OpenAPI/REST API spec (404s across candidate paths), and there's no evidence that Kanban-specific features (task board, worktree management UI) or all approval/mode-toggle UI interactions are fully exposed programmatically. missing for 10: a documented formal API/OpenAPI spec, explicit parity proof for Kanban board features via CLI/API, independent confirmation that CLI covers 100% of UI capabilities.
